title: Marcos: ASEAN embodies 'kapwa' through cooperation, close ties among nations
summary: President Marcos Jr. said relations among members of the ASEAN are sustained through cooperation to strengthen peace and opportunities, highlighting the Filipino term "kapwa."

blocks.text: President Ferdinand "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. on Monday said relations among members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) are sustained through cooperation to strengthen peace and opportunities, highlighting the Filipino term "kapwa."

"There is something of kapwa in the ASEAN story. We remain different nations with our own histories, interests, and aspirations. ASEAN has never asked us to become less or different from ourselves," Marcos said in his opening speech during the gala dinner at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City.

"We have learned that the peace of our neighbors strengthens our own peace, that prosperity shared across borders creates opportunity at home, and that when one part of our region is tested, the effects rarely stop at the national boundary," he added.
The Philippines also showcased its hospitality to the ASEAN delegates through Filipino food and performances.
During a press briefing at the International Media Center also in Pasay, Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro said the Philippines will showcase its food and artistry during the gala night.
"It will be really showcasing the food as well as the artistry of the Filipino," Lazaro said.
"There will be a group of people, excellent [and] creative people who will definitely be showcasing the Philippines of its best," she added.
The delegates were welcomed with a Filipino folk dances in their vibrant attires, as well the higantes or giant puppets. — BM, GMA News
